description: Copy / Share per argument. Add two small, unobtrusive, on-theme, keyboard-accessible actions to each ArgumentCard: 'Copy' (clean plain-text block of the argument + references) and 'Link' (absolute deep link to that argument). Requires threading an optional topicId prop from TopicPage down to ArgumentCard. Ordered after FEAT-001 (theme) and FEAT-002 so it edits the already-themed ArgumentCard; independent of FEAT-004.
steps: In src/components/ArgumentCard.tsx add an optional prop `topicId?: string` to ArgumentCardProps (do NOT change the data model types in src/data/types.ts — this is a component prop).

In src/pages/TopicPage.tsx, pass topicId to every ArgumentCard: `<ArgumentCard key={arg.id} argument={arg} topicId={topicId} />` (topicId comes from useParams; it is `string | undefined` — ArgumentCard must handle undefined gracefully, disabling/hiding the Link button or falling back to the current pathname).

In ArgumentCard add a small action area (icon buttons) near the StrengthBadge in the header OR in a footer row — unobtrusive and on-theme (gold/ink, theme-aware). Add a 'Copy' button and a 'Link' button, each >=44px tap target, with aria-labels and keyboard focusability (native <button>).

Implement Copy: build a clean plain-text block = argument `title`, then each primaryReferences entry formatted as `<citation> (<translationUsed>) — <text>`, then the `shortClaim` (include it). Copy via `navigator.clipboard.writeText(text)` wrapped in try/catch with a graceful fallback (create a temporary textarea, select, document.execCommand('copy'), remove) for insecure contexts/older browsers.

Implement Link: copy `${window.location.origin}/topic/${topicId}#${id}` using the same clipboard helper. If topicId is undefined, fall back to `${window.location.origin}${window.location.pathname}#${id}`.

Add a brief, accessible 'Copied' confirmation: a small transient label/toast with `aria-live="polite"` (or role=status) that appears for ~1.5s after a successful copy of either button, then clears. Must not shift layout jarringly. Respect prefers-reduced-motion if animated.
Factor the clipboard write + fallback + 'copied' state into a tiny local helper or a src/hooks/useCopy.ts hook if it keeps ArgumentCard clean. Keep it self-contained.
Update README.md: add a 'Copy & share arguments' section documenting the per-argument Copy (plain-text citation block) and Link (deep link to /topic/<id>#<argumentId>) buttons.
acceptance_criteria: Each ArgumentCard shows unobtrusive, on-theme, keyboard-accessible Copy and Link buttons (>=44px tap targets, aria-labels) that work in both light and dark themes.

Copy places on the clipboard a plain-text block containing the title, each reference as `<citation> (<translationUsed>) — <text>`, and the shortClaim; a fallback path exists when navigator.clipboard is unavailable.
Link places on the clipboard an absolute URL `${origin}/topic/${topicId}#${argumentId}` (with a pathname fallback when topicId is undefined).
An aria-live 'Copied' confirmation appears briefly after a successful copy.
topicId is threaded from TopicPage to ArgumentCard via an optional prop; src/data/types.ts data shapes are unchanged.
npm run build and npm run typecheck both exit 0.
The deep link, when pasted, lands on the correct argument (same route pattern the search modal already uses).
verification: Run `npm run build` and `npm run typecheck` from repo root — both must exit 0 (confirms the optional topicId prop and clipboard code typecheck under strict).
Read ArgumentCard.tsx + TopicPage.tsx to confirm the prop is threaded and the Copy/Link text formats match the spec.

Confirm the generated link format matches resultHref() in src/search/searchIndex-driven SearchModal (/topic/<topicId>#<argumentId>) so deep links resolve. Do NOT start a dev server/preview (port 5317 in use).
findings:
Added src/hooks/useCopy.ts (Clipboard API + <textarea>/execCommand('copy') fallback, auto-clearing `copied` flag ~1.5s). ArgumentCard: added optional `topicId?: string` prop (component prop only; src/data/types.ts untouched) and two unobtrusive, theme-aware icon buttons (Copy, Link) in the header beside StrengthBadge, each min-h-[44px] min-w-[44px], native <button> with aria-labels. Copy builds `title`

`<citation> (<translationUsed>) — <text>` per primaryReferences entry 

`shortClaim`. Link copies `${origin}/topic/${topicId}#${id}` with `${origin}${pathname}#${id}` fallback when topicId is undefined — matches resultHref() in SearchModal (/topic/<topicId>#<argumentId>), so deep links resolve to the hash-scroll+flash effect. Transient 'Copied' confirmation: visually-hidden aria-live=polite role=status span + a visible gold pill (aria-hidden) that only appears when copied, using motion-safe:animate-[fade-in_150ms]. Added a `fade-in` @keyframes to src/index.css (motion-safe variant means reduced-motion users get no animation). TopicPage threads topicId={topicId} (string|undefined from useParams) to every ArgumentCard. README: new 'Copy & share arguments' section. Verified: `npm run typecheck` and `npm run build` both exit 0; fade-in + sr-only present in dist CSS.
